companyContext: Compagnie des Alpes is a European leader in leisure, operating major French ski resorts and theme parks across Europe. A subsidiary of the Caisse des dépôts et consignations, it has operated Parc Astérix since the park's opening in 1989. The group also manages other leisure brands including Walibi, Futuroscope, and Grévin. In 2024-2025 it achieved record revenues and announced a €250 million investment plan for Parc Astérix through 2030, aiming to reach the top 5 European theme parks.
brandContext: Parc Astérix is France's second most-visited theme park (behind Disneyland Paris), welcoming over 2.8 million visitors annually. Located 35 km north of Paris in Plailly (Oise), the park is based on the iconic comic book series Astérix by René Goscinny and Albert Uderzo. It features 50+ attractions and shows spread across themed zones: Gaul, the Roman Empire, Ancient Greece, Egypt, the Vikings, and Through Time. The 2026 season (April 4, 2026 – January 3, 2027) marks a milestone with the completed renovation of the Egypt zone, a brand-new nighttime drone/laser/pyrotechnic lake show, and the Gallic Summer (L'Été Gaulois) from July 11 to August 30 with extended hours until 10pm, featuring the Gaulish Feast, the Gallic Parade, water rides, and family entertainment.

brandVision: To become a top-5 European theme park by 2030 through a €250 million investment plan, expanding themed zones (Egypt 2026, Greece 2027, Londinium 2028), adding a fourth hotel (300 rooms, 2027), launching innovative nighttime spectacles, and internationalizing the brand with a second Parc Astérix in Germany (Leipzig, 2030-2031). The park aims to evolve from a single-day attraction into a multi-day leisure destination while preserving the humour, authenticity, and irreverent spirit of the Astérix comic-book universe.
brandValues: Parc Astérix's motto is 'Travailler sérieusement sans se prendre au sérieux' (Work seriously without taking yourself seriously). Core values include: Humanism & Benevolence – prioritising team well-being and genuine human connection with visitors; Team Spirit – recognising collective success as a cornerstone, inspired by the indomitable Gaulish village; Agility & Inventiveness – adapting quickly and finding creative solutions, like the irreducible Gauls themselves; Joy & Good Humour – spreading smiles as the primary asset, delivering delight to every visitor; Innovation & Daring – experimenting boldly, testing new ideas, and finding the best possible solutions; Environmental Responsibility – committing to reduced environmental impact through sustainable practices such as recycled-paper campaigns and green certifications (PEFC, Imprim'vert).
